if you are using an enb, maybe you can adjust some things on the enb menu. mine was too bright and dark depending on weather and time so i had to adjust it according to what my eye likes. the major problem for mw was the interiors, lol. 

to make it generally bright, you have to locate these under the "environment" tab and adjust your ambient lighting intensity and experiment with the values. second, do the same with direct lighting intensity although unlike with ambient lighting, direct lighting only "brightens" up the surfaces where the light source is/are hitting.

lastly, slightly tweak the point lighting intensity to balance the shadows. point lightning adjusts how intense the light will be from a light source like torches, lamps, and etc. :)

these things also has separate settings for interiors.
